notes.title: Bug fixing: Version 1.0.6 is up!
notes.content:
Hello all!

It's been over a month since our previous update, and it's because we have released the Nintendo Switch version in the meantime! Yay! It doesn't mean that we have slacked off on the PC version, but we have had to fix issues on both platforms, so we just packed everything together. Here is the list of fixes brought by this 1.0.6 update:

[list]
[*] Firefly achievement is now fixed;
[*] Fixed issues with minions on level 7, The Forgotten City, and level 9, the Underground Market, that could see Pierre stuck with no possibility to move;
[*] fixed dialogue issues and freezes in some levels.
[/list]

If after updating to version 1.0.6 (version number appears on the lower right corner of your screen when launching the game), you still encounter any of those bugs, please let us know in the comments here or on our [url=https://discord.gg/HD9ZxWy7Ud]Discord[/url]

[h2]Issue Feedback[/h2]
When reporting any issue, please let us know:
[list]
[*] Your system specs (RAM, CPU, GPU, OS + architecture (32 or 64 bits), and any additional information that you think is relevant)
[*] What you were doing when the bug happened (launched a new game, accessing a level already played, etc.)
[*] Any other information that you think is relevant
[/list]

See you soon in Opera City!

notes.title: Bug fixing: Version 1.0.4 is up!
notes.content:
Hello all!

It has been a week since the last update, and it is because we have been working on the remaining bugs in the game that seem to plague a few players here and there, notably the cage in the Haunted Mansion level. We are happy to say that it has finally been fixed, and you should now be able to reopen the cage upon entering it. Yay!
Please find the list of fixes below:

[list]
[*] fix some chests that would keep their collected state after creating a new clean save;
[*] fix achievements progression;
[*] fix a situation where some players would not be able to re-open the cage in the Haunted Mansion level.
[/list]

If after updating to version 1.0.4 (version number appears on the lower right corner of your screen when launching the game), you still encounter any of those bugs, please let us know in the comments here or on our [url=https://discord.gg/HD9ZxWy7Ud]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Bug fixing: Version 1.0.2 is up!
notes.content:
Hello all!

After another day of fixing, we are happy to give you version 1.0.2! This new version focused mainly on collectibles and their management within the game. You will now be able to reset your progression within the game to find those collectibles again! Or, should you feel so inclined, train yourself for that sweet, sweet speedrun 100% world record! But that's not all that has been fixed, so please find a more complete list here:

[list]
[*] added a warning validation popup when selecting "new game" in the main menu;
[*] you can remove all progress & collectibles by ticking the remove box when selecting "new game" in the main menu (this won't remove unlocked levels);
[*] small graphics fixes;
[*] improved achievements tracking;
[*] fix an issue when navigating too fast within menus;
[*] reworked the collection menu readability.
[/list]

If after updating to version 1.0.2 (version number appears on the lower right corner of your screen when launching the game), you still encounter any of those bugs, please let us know in the comments here or on our [url=https://discord.gg/HD9ZxWy7Ud]Discord[/url]

[h2]Issue Feedback[/h2]
When reporting any issue, please let us know:
[list]

[*] What you were doing when the bug happened (launched a new game, accessing a level already played, etc.)
[*] Any other information that you think is relevant

See you soon in Opera City!

notes.title: Bug fixing: Version 1.0.1 is up!
notes.content:
Hello all!

Labyrinth City: Pierre the Maze Detective launched yesterday and we are super happy and proud to see so many of you enjoyed the game so far!

Alas, even after extensive testing (until the very last minute actually), some players have encountered a few bugs that hindered their enjoyment of the game. However, our little hands have been working hard yesterday in order to fix some of the most recurring issues: 

[list]
[*] fix pause screen issues
[*] fix grabbing the kite in level 4
[*] cinematic videos volume is now linked to SFX volume in options
[*] fix an issue where you could stay stuck in a "one way" minion
[/list]

If after updating to version 1.0.1 (version number appears on the lower right corner of your screen when launching the game), you still encounter any of those bugs, please let us know in the Steam Hub or on our [url=https://discord.gg/HD9ZxWy7Ud]Discord[/url]

[h2]Issue Feedback[/h2]
When reporting any issue, please let us know:

[list]
[*] Your system specs (RAM, CPU, GPU, OS + architecture (32 or 64 bits), and any additional information that you think is relevant)
[*] What you were doing when the bug happened (launched a new game, accessing a level already played, etc.)
[*] Any other information that you think is relevant
[/list]

We hope this fixes will help you enjoy your stay in Opera City more!
